theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Tactical Gaming Variant)
theme_and_archetype.description: A high-energy, command-center feel focusing on clear deal hierarchies. Avoids generic tech-purple. Uses deep obsidian (dark) or crisp off-white (light) with high-contrast Acid Green / Crimson accents to highlight savings.

rules.headings: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), never use Inter for headings. Use uppercase + wide spacing for labels/overline.
rules.body: Clean geometric sans with readable line-height.
rules.rtl_support: Ensure fonts support Arabic characters properly (e.g., Cairo or Noto Sans Arabic as fallback for Arabic locale).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. Tailwind p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped deal cards.
layout_and_spacing.hero_section: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical layout for featured/trending deals.
layout_and_spacing.deals_grid: Mode B: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.rtl_guidelines: CRITICAL: Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., `ps-4` instead of `pl-4`, `ms-2` instead of `ml-2`, `start-0` instead of `left-0`). This ensures layout flips automatically for Arabic LTR/RTL support.

deal_card.structure: Flat background, 1px subtle border. No heavy shadows in dark mode.
deal_card.hierarchy: 1. Game Cover (max-h-48 object-cover). 2. Title. 3. Price Block (Old price strikethrough -> New price -> % off Badge). 4. Platform Icons.
deal_card.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color brightens to accent_secondary.

buttons.primary: Solid high-contrast color. In dark mode: bg-[#D4FF00] text-black hover:bg-[#bce600]. In light mode: bg-black text-[#D4FF00].

badges.discount: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). bg-[#D4FF00] text-black font-black for max visibility.

header.style: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl with 1px bottom border. Must support Theme Toggle and Language Switcher.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react for UI icons. react-icons (FaSteam, FaXbox, FaPlaystation, SiEpicgames) for platform logos.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract dark tactical tech background for dark mode hero
Abstract white high-contrast background for light mode hero

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind layout logical properties (`start`, `end`, `ps`, `pe`, `ms`, `me`) globally to support standard LTR to RTL automatic flipping for Arabic.
Ensure 1px borders are present on deal cards to maintain the 'Performance Pro' technical structure.
For the language switcher, implement Arabic (ar) applying `dir='rtl'` on the html tag.
Do NOT use typical generic violet/purple gaming colors; strictly adhere to the tactical Obsidian/Off-white base with Acid Green/Electric Crimson accents.
Ensure strict APCA accessible contrast on all buttons and overlays.
Create the app using Javascript (.js/.jsx) files. DO NOT output .tsx files.
Integrate Shadcn primitives (customized to remove generic Vercel look).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key UI cards.
